# docs-code-sync — 2026-04-14

**3 stale sections found, 3 fixed** across 5 changed files.

## What changed in code

- `src/commands/server.ts` — Intelligence provider priority reversed (CLI now default, API opt-in)
- `src/messaging/TelegramAdapter.ts` — 401 retry logic (30s pause, one retry before fatal stop)
- `src/core/CoherenceReviewer.ts` / `CoherenceGate.ts` — `intelligence` param added for subscription routing
- `src/monitoring/probes/MessagingProbe.ts` — richer probe diagnostics using new status fields

## Updates committed (537cc55)

1. **docs/messaging-platform-parity.md** — Added row 15.8 (Telegram 401 error handling) and changelog entry 2.22 for v0.28.36
2. **docs/specs/TESTING-INTEGRITY-SPEC.md** — Wiring example updated to reflect CLI-first intelligence provider priority

## No uncertain items, no overflow
